formal_statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℂ (Fin M → ℂ)), (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 0) → (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i, x i ^ 3 = 0) → 3 * Module.finrank ℂ W ≤ M
plain_statement: If W in C^M is a linear subspace with sum x_i^2 = 0 and sum x_i^3 = 0 for every x in W, then dim W <= M/3. Sharp (blocks (1,a,b) with 1+a^2+b^2 = 1+a^3+b^3 = 0). Conjecture of this project; numerics agree for M <= 12. With L-gct-035 and the Sigma_m reduction it gives dc(perm_m) >= 2m^2/3 - O(m).
title: Fermat lemma: a complex linear space on which both power sums x1^2+...+xM^2 and x1^3+...+xM^3 vanish has dimension at most M/3
